newsitem.title: USA: Immudyne says sued over patents.
newsitem.headline: Immudyne says sued over patents.

text.p: ImmuDyne Inc said Tuesday Carmel Research Inc filed a complaint in U.S. District Court, District of Nevada, alleging infringement of two patents related to beta glucan technology.

ImmuDyne, a Texas-based biotechnology company, said a Nevada court initially issued a temporary restraining order requiring that it stop selling its MacroForce dietary supplement products that contain beta glucan.
ImmuDyne said the judge later dissolved the order, however, after the company submitted additional information. Immudyne said it is again selling its MacroForce products.
It said a hearing on the complaint has been set for Thursday to determine if a new temporary injunction will be ordered.
ImmuDyne said it does not believe the allegations have merit.
